title.narrative: Equipo Maiz-Stengthening editiorial processes & broadening editorial services to other organisations

description.narrative: Whilst levels of community organisation in El Salvador and throughout Central America are relatively good, grassroots sectors of civil society are often lacking basic information, analysis and understanding about the economic and political systems, structures and trends that shape their reality and impact their lives and livelihoods. There are very few spaces for systematic training of grassroots and community leaders and educators (agents of change) in education, analysis and reflection and a scarcity of publishing houses dedicated to producing quality, digestible educational support materials on social, economic, political and environmental development issues. Equipo Maíz is dedicated to popular education through publications and training and aims to facilitate learning and analysis at the grassroots on issues that affect local people, to enable them to have a better understanding of these issues and the capacity to propose alternative policies. It aims to increase people’s commitment to social justice and encourage them to take an active role in creating change. Through this project Equipo Maíz will provide training for over 1,000 agents of social change, as well as producing new and re-editing existing publications and materials.
